meaning:
βιόω, -ῶ
(βίος), [in LXX: Pro.7:2 9:6 (חיה), Job.29:18, Wis.4:4 א 1, 12:23, Sir.40:28, 4Ma.5:22 17:18 * ;]
to spend life, to live: τ. χρόνον βιῶσαι (cl., more frequently 2 aor., -ναι), 1Pe.4:2 (cf. Jb, l.with).†
SYN.: ζάω (which see). (AS)

elsewhere.note: that you no longer should live the rest of your time in the flesh for the lusts of men, but for the will of God.
